domains.title: Engineering Mathematics
domains.subtitle: Calculus, differential systems, and linear geometry that form the language of modern engineering.

lessons.title: Derivatives & Instantaneous Rate of Change
lessons.description: Collapse secant chords into tangent vectors on live 3D surfaces, build geometric intuition for slopes and curvature, and master product, quotient, and chain rule decompositions step by step.

lessons.title: Integrals, Accumulation & Flux
lessons.description: Refine 3D Riemann glass slices into continuous area, visualize the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus, and master u-substitution, trig identities, integration by parts, and partial fractions step by step.

lessons.title: Differential Equations & Laplace Transforms
lessons.description: Explore 3D damped spring-mass phase helices, drag poles directly across the complex Laplace s-plane, and solve separable, integrating-factor, 2nd-order ODEs, and Laplace IVPs step by step.

lessons.title: Linear Algebra, Eigenvalues & Transforms
lessons.description: Warp 3D vector spaces interactively to watch eigenvectors lock onto their spans, drag 2D basis vectors to explore determinants and SVD ellipses, and solve matrix, eigen, Gram-Schmidt, and least-squares problems step by step.

domains.title: Mechatronics & Control Systems
domains.subtitle: Closed-loop feedback, robotic mechanisms, and real-time dynamical models linking sensors to actuators.

lessons.title: PID Control & Feedback Stability
lessons.description: Tune live P, I, and D gains on a 3D servo & disturbance rig, dissect proportional/integral/derivative control effort waveforms, and master closed-loop transfer functions, Routh-Hurwitz stability, Ziegler-Nichols tuning, and phase margins step by step.

lessons.title: Forward & Inverse Robot Kinematics
lessons.description: Manipulate multi-axis joint spaces, Denavit-Hartenberg transforms, and Jacobian velocity mappings on a 3D robotic arm.

lessons.title: State-Space Modeling & Signals
lessons.description: Formulate coupled electromechanical systems in matrix state space and analyze poles, controllability, and frequency response.

domains.title: Theoretical Physics
domains.subtitle: Variational principles, electromagnetic fields, and quantum wave mechanics visualized in geometric detail.

lessons.title: Lagrangian & Hamiltonian Mechanics
lessons.description: Derive equations of motion from stationary action and watch trajectories evolve across energy-conserving phase spaces.

lessons.title: Maxwell's Equations & Vector Fields
lessons.description: Inspect divergence, curl, and propagating electromagnetic waves in an interactive 3D field laboratory.

lessons.title: Quantum States & Wavefunctions
lessons.description: Visualize complex probability amplitudes, superposition interference, and stationary eigenstates in confining potentials.

domains.title: AI & Machine Learning
domains.subtitle: High-dimensional optimization, automatic differentiation, and geometric sequence architectures.

lessons.title: Multivariable Gradients & Backpropagation
lessons.description: Trace reverse-mode chain-rule gradients through computational graphs and steer optimizers across non-convex loss landscapes.

lessons.title: Transformers & Geometric Attention
lessons.description: See query-key inner products, softmax routing, and multi-head projections dynamically shape token representations in 3D.
